item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Add a small uniform pairwise ranking auxiliary loss to the existing weighted objective. The 0.03 coefficient may improve margins across valid targets with limited disruption. Applies to all four datasets without changing sampling, architecture, inference, or training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.03 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Retain the current loss and add 0.03 times mean softplus(negative score − positive score) over valid targets using existing sampled negatives."}
